purpose: Make specific care-worker and manager constraints readable in the broad map without generic ICP-only context lines. Editorial refinement of existing hypotheses, not new evidence or new navigation identities.

counts.selection: 30 care-worker situations and30 additional manager situations; overlapping perspectives retained on one graph.

preserved: Needs→situations→existing offerings hierarchy and all links
Research questions, proposed scopes and measurement status
All source rows and media associations
scope.validation: Exact pre-change revision/scope/provenance guards, six-table private backups, audited batch transaction and post-write all-row preservation checks on isolated and canonical databases. All60 exact projected context lines checked.
scope.limits: Editorial context is not an interview, observed event, prevalence, causal validation or clinical/legal guidance. Existing titles and candidate rationales are the only premises.

worker_branch.title: I need to help people keep their mouths comfortable and healthy

manager_branch.title: I need the organisation to remain dependable when key leaders leave

observations: Canonical reload displayed updated situation summaries in both branches.
Zoom85→102→85 retained the same five worker situations and text.
ArrowRight panned the first worker item from x=-140 to x=-190 without changing content.
Clicking the incoming-manager situation entered its next map level. Its empty solution level explicitly states research coverage is incomplete.
The manager situation record still displayed Hypothesis and validation-pending information. Map summaries are not repeated in the detailed record, which retains its existing full statement.
Short breadcrumbs returned to the five-situation manager map.
Authorised neutral placeholders remain; no generated or reused misleading imagery added.

An accessibility announcement reported intermittent background refresh failure. CSS and screenshot inspection confirmed it is a1px clipped screen-reader status, not a visible banner. No UI change was made; refresh reliability was not fixed.
